roles.name: ENGINEER
roles.strength: Power, bulkheads and the reactor. Handles a fight badly.

roles.name: SECURITY
roles.strength: The only role that can reliably put something down, and the best at making it go somewhere else.

roles.name: MEDIC
roles.strength: Cuts infection out of the deck faster than anyone. Absorbs wounds.
roles.weakness: Slow, and hits like a clipboard.

roles.name: SURVEYOR
roles.strength: Moves silently, reads the ship at four compartments, lives in the vents.

roles.name: PILOT
roles.strength: Banks the shuttle from anywhere and lifts on less.
roles.weakness: Weakest at everything that is not leaving.
